propositions: The tickets branch must not trigger any GitHub Actions workflows on push, enforced by appending 'tickets' to the branches-ignore list in four workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml).
A new enumerating test must validate that no workflow file in .github/workflows/ matches a push to the tickets branch, and must fail if a future workflow is added with a bare on.push key.

Schedule-based workflow triggers must remain byte-identical across the change (reconcile-bridge */20 * * * *, verify-identity 53 */6 * * *, test 41 */6 * * *, optionality 47 */6 * * *, prompt-eval weekly 0 7 * * 1).
Adopter documentation must warn against CI triggered by tickets-branch auto-pushes in docs/concurrency.md (canonical), with cross-links in docs/user-guide.md and docs/config.md.
Push CI for ordinary topic branches (wip-*) must continue to trigger the four edited workflows, and gerrit-verify.yaml must remain workflow_dispatch-only.
